These are separated into two distinct functional requirements based on the structure of the original text and business rule BR-01.

source_fragments: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems
structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems.
structuring_notes: Decomposed from the original statement. This addresses the first mandatory action.
